audit.recompute_scope: every value in this block is recomputable from the retained raw rows

cycle_projector_defect.role: prespecified descriptive secondary C1 endpoint; no decision

c1.design: 12 independent ambient minimum-norm least-squares training/noise replicates per topology with one common independently generated noiseless test set
c1.estimator: within-topology conventional Pearson r, clipped inside (-1,1), then Fisher atanh and seed-level Student-t aggregation

matched_random_subspace_defect.role: specificity sensitivity analysis; no confirmatory decision

paired_specificity_delta_fisher_z.definition: cycle-projector Fisher z minus random-projector Fisher z
paired_specificity_delta_fisher_z.role: descriptive paired specificity contrast; no decision

ambient_adam_vs_min_norm_ls.role: descriptive optimizer diagnostic; outside the primary family

generator_cycle_basis_oracle.role: descriptive attainability ceiling; outside efficacy inference

optimization_audits.stationarity_role: descriptive stationarity gap of each learned arm's training objective; outside the primary family

soft_boundary_adam_vs_closed_form.role: descriptive optimizer-gap diagnostic; outside the primary family

design.eligibility: all connected generated cases with F >= 3; no replacement

inner_cv_ridge.refit: closed-form ridge on all 16 training rows
inner_cv_ridge.selection: minimum mean fold MSE; exact ties choose smaller alpha

design.paired_arm_sharing: within each seed all primary arms share topology, train inputs, label noise, test inputs, noiseless targets, and learned initialization
design.subseed_derivation: first eight big-endian bytes of SHA256('homymoly-lifting-v2:' + topology_seed + ':' + component + ':' + replicate), masked to 63 bits

claims.description: soft boundary compatibility improves over the v1 ambient Adam reference
hard cycle-subspace least squares improves over ambient minimum-norm least squares
hard cycle-subspace least squares improves over the closed-form frozen soft objective
the true cycle subspace improves over a dimension-matched random subspace
training-only-selected ridge improves over ambient minimum-norm least squares
the singular-value surrogate harms versus ambient Adam
futility bound: rule out an RTD-inspired benefit of 10% or more

primary.estimand: mean paired log10 held-out-MSE ratio over eligible seeds
primary.exchangeability_assumption: eligible seed-level joint realizations are exchangeable; topology and data/noise heterogeneity are not separated
primary.inference_unit: one eligible generator seed jointly determining topology, predictors, and noise
primary.method: one-sided Student-t bounds with Bonferroni correction
